add_subdirectory(cmicontrol)
add_subdirectory(cpl)

# For (NT6+) WaveRT support.
# See WAVERT define in debug.hpp.
# remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
# add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600)

if(ARCH STREQUAL "i386")
    add_cd_file(FILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/CM8738-x32.inf" DESTINATION reactos/inf FOR all)
else()
    add_cd_file(FILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/CM8738-x64.inf" DESTINATION reactos/inf FOR all)
endif()

# cmipci.sys is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/cmipci-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(cmipci_shims OBJECT adapter.cpp common.cpp mintopo.cpp minwave.cpp guid.cpp)
target_link_libraries(cmipci_shims PRIVATE stdunk libcntpr uuid libportcls libhal libntoskrnl)
target_compile_definitions(cmipci_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU" OR CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang")
    target_compile_options(cmipci_shims PRIVATE -Wno-write-strings -Wno-switch)
endif()
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang")
    target_compile_options(cmipci_shims PRIVATE -Wno-enum-constexpr-conversion)
endif()
add_cargo_module(cmipci cmipci-cargo cmipci.sys
    KIND wdmdriver
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/drivers
    EXTRA_DEPENDS cmipci_shims psdk asm uuid_sources xdk)
